search_text: published ZDI-17-061 ZDI-CAN-4007 Trend Micro Control Manager download Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2017-02-07 4.3 ['Trend Micro'] ['Control Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Control Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within widget's download.php script. The issue lies in the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code under the context of the iusr account.
